rootCause: The previous emergency heap increase lets one extension-host child reserve more heap than physical RAM. Pagefile expansion increases commit capacity but cannot prevent VS Code renderer/window termination from physical-memory pressure and paging stalls.
repairPlan: Change only JDT max heap from 32 GiB to 8 GiB; retain automatic/full Java features and single concurrent build setting. Reload is required for the running process to adopt it.
